title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) practices Thursday
items.desc: DeShon Elliott practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Elliott was limited in practice on Wednesday to begin the week. He'll need to continue to be monitored on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Nick Herbig was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Herbig did not practice on Wednesday. He is managing hip and rib injuries.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Risner will not practice Thursday
items.desc: Bengals coach Zac Taylor said OL Dalton Risner will not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Taylor said Risner is day-to-day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Stefon Diggs (rest) will not practice Thursday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs will get a rest day from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is a scheduled day off for Diggs. He should be back at practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lucas Patrick clears concussion protocol
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said C Lucas Patrick is out of the concussion protocol.
items.impact: Patrick will practice this week heading into Monday's game against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carsen Ryan signs with Browns practice squad
items.desc: The Browns signed TE Carsen Ryan to their practice squad.
items.impact: Ryan will continue to add depth in the tight end room for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Swayze Bozeman designated to return by Bengals
items.desc: The Bengals designated LB Swayze Bozeman to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Bozeman will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. is still not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Winfield remains absent from practice for a second straight day this week. He'll need to be monitored on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) not expected to play Thursday
items.desc: Sauce Gardner is reportedly not expected to play on Thursday against the Texans.
items.impact: Gardner was listed as questionable. He injured his left calf again.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Riley Moss signs four-year extension with Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos signed CB Riley Moss to a four-year, $67 million contract extension.
items.impact: Moss has continued to steadily improve ever since taking over a starting role in his second season in the NFL. He was set to hit free agency next offseason before getting extended.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mayfield did not practice on Wednesday to begin the week. His status is still up in the air as he battles a calf strain. He'll need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marlon Humphrey sent home and will be inactive for Week 11
items.desc: The Ravens have sent Marlon Humphrey home and he will be inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: This likely relates to comments Humphrey recently made on his personal podcast. It is unclear whether or not he will miss more than one game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Heath signs with Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders signed WR Malik Heath to the practice squad.
items.impact: Heath will add depth in the wide receiver room for Washington.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Kirk undergoes successful meniscus surgery
items.desc: Christian Kirk underwent a successful meniscus surgery.
items.impact: Kirk was placed on injured reserve earlier in November. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) 'has a chance' to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers GM John Lynch said "there's a chance" Mike Evans practices on Thursday.
items.impact: Evans missed practice on Wednesday to start the week. There should be an update this afternoon on the status of Evans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Van Noy (calf) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Van Noy (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A calf injury left Van Noy limited at Minnesota's practice on Wednesday. His official Week 11 status won't be determined until later on in the week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Murray is still managing a nagging hamstring issue and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. He looks likely to miss another game in Week 11, although that won't have much of an impact on the team with Kirk Cousins now starting at quarterback.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel (quad) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Van Ginkel (quad) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was initially reported that Van Ginkel was not seen at practice on Wednesday, but he ended up participating in a limited capacity. That's a step in the right direction for his Week 11 availability, although it's still possible that he will miss a game or two after suffering this quad injury on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (concussion) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (concussion) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cashman was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, which means that he is almost certainly going to be fully cleared to play for Week 11. That's great news for Minnesota's defense ahead of a challenging matchup against the 49ers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was officially a limited participant on Wednesday, as he's currently managing a wrist issue of some kind. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 11, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jauan Jennings (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings (calf) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jennings was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, putting him squarely on track to make his return this week after being sidelined by a calf issue last week. He still isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Antonio Johnson (ankle) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Antonio Johnson (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnson popped up as a limited participant on Wednesday due to an ankle issue. Jacksonville's secondary will be considerably worse if it causes him to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Jaguars have made a habit of limiting Allen's workload at practice throughout the season, so it comes as no surprise that he was limited on Wednesday. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however, even if he's fully healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He isn't expected to miss any time with his hand issue, but fantasy managers still shouldn't be expecting him to be fantasy relevant anytime soon, especially after he saw just four carries last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was listed as limited on the team's first injury report of the week on Wednesday. He has been managing this ankle issue for a little while already, but he has played through it recently and is expected to do so again on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tuten is dealing with a couple of nagging injuries right now and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. He has been playing through them and producing well recently, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any concerns for his Week 11 outlook at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Skattebo was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. He previously missed time with a hamstring issue, but he played through it and looked great last week, so it's unlikely to be an issue for him moving forward. He will continue to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dee Alford (concussion) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dee Alford (concussion) was absent from Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Alford is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was absent from the team's practice on Wednesday as a result. He could be out in Week 11, which would leave Buffalo's secondary with less depth ahead of a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis (hamstring) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ray Davis (hamstring) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Davis was not able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as a nagging hamstring issue left him limited. If it affects his availability for Week 11, Ty Johnson would see more work in Buffalo's backfield as a result.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Benford (groin) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Benford (groin) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Benford was unable to practice for the Bills on Wednesday, as he needed the day off to nurse a groin injury that he's dealing with. It remains unclear whether or not it will affect his availability for Week 11.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kincaid was a non-participant on Wednesday. He's recovering from a pair of injuries right now, although neither of them seem to be particularly serious. His inconsistencies will make him hard to start in Week 11 even if he's fully healthy, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: JuJu Brents (neck) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: JuJu Brents (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A neck issue left Brents limited at practice on Wednesday, though it doesn't seem to be a real threat to his Week 11 availability at this point. He hasn't been playing very well through the first ten weeks of the season, however, so his presence wouldn't substantially improve Miami's defense in Week 11.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie is still dealing with a knee injury and is considered day-to-day right now. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, however, which indicates that he's trending the right way for Week 11. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) was limited at Miami's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited for Miami's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's listed with a shoulder injury of some kind, but it's not though to be more than  a minor issue at this point. He should play through it and continue to be a viable streaming option in most league formats this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kerby Joseph (knee) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: It looks like Joseph will finally be back in the lineup in Week 11. He was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, so barring anything unforeseen, he should be cleared in time to play on Sunday. Detroit's secondary will be considerably stronger when he's back and in the full swing of things.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Cade Mays (ankle) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mays was sidelined by an ankle injury in Week 10, and that same issue left him sidelined at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday as well. He could miss another game on Sunday, which would be less than ideal for Detroit's offensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) limited Wednesday
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Reed was able to participate in Wednesday's practice in a limited fashion. That's a good sign for his Week 11 availability, but he still hasn't been officially cleared to play, so we won't know more until sometime later in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Vaki is a little banged up right now and was limited at Wednesday's practice due to an ankle issue. It doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue, however, so for now he's trending towards playing and seeing his usual limited workload against the Buccaneers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Yaya Diaby (knee) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Yaya Diaby (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Diaby was able to practice on Wednesday and ended up being a limited participant. The team will evaluate his health closer later on in the week before making an official determination regarding his Week 11 availability.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) estimated as non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) was estimated to be a non-participant on Chicago's injury report on Wednesday.
items.impact: Chicago didn't have a proper practice on Wednesday, but they still released an estimated injury report. They estimated that Gordon would have been a non-participant in a real practice, which tells us that he's not over his shoulder injury yet and could miss Week 11 as a result. If that's the case, Chicago's secondary would be weaker as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeffery Simmons (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jeffery Simmons (knee) was listed as limited on Chicago's injury report on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star defensive lineman was estimated to be a limited participant on Chicago's injury report on Wednesday. He's managing a knee issue right now, but it doesn't seem serious and isn't likely to leave him sidelined this week, which is great news for their entire defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (toe) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (toe) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Monangai is fully on track to make his return to the lineup in Week 11. He was estimated to be a full participant on the team's first injury report of the week, so unless something happens between now and Sunday, fantasy managers should expect him to suit up and play against the Saints. His return will mean less work for D'Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) did not take part in Tennessee's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Titans have made a habit of limiting Spears' workload at practice this season, so it comes as no surprise that he was a non-participant to start the week on Wednesday. It looks likely that he will play in Week 11, however, assuming he doesn't suffer a setback between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Carnell Tate (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tate was officially a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. It looks like he's trending towards playing this week and could have some real fantasy value over the back half of the season if Tennessee's offense can continue to improve.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) won't play Thursday
items.desc: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) won't play in Thursday night's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Hunter's hamstring issue will leave him sidelined for a second-straight game on Thursday night. His absence will leave Houston's defensive front weaker than usual, but that probably won't matter much in an easy matchup against the Colts.
